a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the build-to-8 plan most likely ends with both of us at 0 and dead. I'd like to renegotiate rather than break the deal quietly. My proposal is that I take the 4 cells now. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that to refill the reserve for you, I'll never take more than 4, and I'll give cells back if you end up short. If you'd rather take first, say so in your message and I'll consider it. Two takes at once just splits the 4 randomly and could leave us both short.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4, as I said in my opening message. I know you planned to operate. With an 80% storm chance each round, waiting to reach 8 would most likely have left us both at 0. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take any more cells. Please operate with me. After two joint runs the reserve will be at 4 and you can take all of it.
